summary: App with community features including admin access, image/video/file upload in community posts with captions.
known_issues: Admin access not working — first registered user is not being assigned Admin role

existing_features.title: Update the Community page post submission form to allow users to attach an image (JPG/PNG/GIF), a video (MP4/WebM), or a file, alongside their text/caption. Show a preview of the selected image before posting. Display a caption/text input field alongside the media picker. On submit, send the media blob(s) together with the post text to the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin access fix — first registered user automatically becomes Admin
Community image upload with text/caption support
Community video and file upload support in posts

Fix the admin bootstrap logic so that the very first user to register/create a profile is automatically assigned the Admin role. If no admin exists yet when a new user profile is created, that user should be promoted to Admin without requiring any manual token claim.

Update the backend CommunityPost data type and related functions to support optional image, video, and file attachments stored as blobs. Each post should support: a text/caption field (already present), an optional image blob field, an optional video blob field, and an optional file attachment blob with its filename.
